title: The local work log is online
summary: A private LAN blog is now available as the independent home for dated Vosslab work notes.

sections.heading: Purpose
paragraphs: This is the new local home for concise, dated notes about Vosslab's development work. The site is independent of the podcast repository and is deliberately small: static pages, local assets, and visible source links.

The next enhancement is a validated daily GitHub commit collector. Until that collector proves attribution, pagination, and source provenance, this site labels public activity snapshots as preliminary rather than calling them complete daily work reports.

sections.heading: Public GitHub activity snapshot
paragraphs: A read-only query of Vosslab's public GitHub event feed observed these five PushEvent records on 2026-08-11. They are activity signals from GitHub's public feed, not a validated enumeration of all commits authored that day.
